description.en:
BAKHTIYAR, Aiiu Mansur ‘^Izz al-Da\vla, 
son of Mu^izz al-Dawla, the Buy id, born 331 
(942-943), succeeded on the death of his father 
356 (967) to the dominion which he had conquered.
description.tr: Ebu Mansur İzzü'd-devle, Büveyhî Muizzü'd-devle oğlu, 331 (942-943 M.) doğumlu, 356'da (967 M.) tahta geçti

derived_from.edition_or_version: Encyclopaedia of Islam, 1st ed. (Brill, 1913-1936), digitized/structured ei1_lite v-repo; OCR-derived — noise possible
